title: Shalmaneser besieges Samaria
description: Shalmaneser besieges Samaria (2 Kgs 17:5). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 723–722 BC. Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was ussher-jones 723 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, rows 723–722, p. 44
chronologies.note: Samaria besieged in Shalmaneser V’s years 4 and 5 (Hezekiah 4–5).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: This is not shalmaneser-i. No Shalmaneser V record was created. fall-of-samaria keeps the CFAH anchor at 722 BC. Jones's 721 BC is on that record as display only.
